claims.assertion: Swaruu says most ships use controlled-gravity tractor beams to move cargo or pull and push large objects.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes a counter-rotating, mercury-filled sphere turbine generating an electromagnetic vortex, shaped by holographic lenses and nano-electromagnets.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu says the beam can project forms or create solid matter and event sequences from energy; created objects persist after beam withdrawal.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says hull sensors measure magnetic and gravitational changes but miss some subatomic values; computers estimate these from predictable parameters.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
